description: This file defines the DetachedTestCase class for running XML-formatted tests in a separate process within the SimpleTest framework. It includes methods for executing tests, parsing XML output, and managing test size information.

classes.name: DetachedTestCase
classes.description: Class for running and managing detached XML tests in the SimpleTest framework.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the test case with command and optional dry run command.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the command associated with this test case.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the test command, parses the XML output, and reports success or failure.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of subtests, executing dry run if size is not yet known.

methods.name: _createParser
methods.description: Creates and returns a new XML parser for processing test output.
